instructions: Process in listed order: inspect the reference image before each edit.
Keep generated images in their specified project output paths; preserve alpha.
Inspect identity, orientation, margins, pose and frame registration before marking an image delivered.
Availability requires reviewed files and delivery recipes; a prompt does not constitute delivery.
Wrapped variants depend on acceptance of the matching barefoot source.

WALK ANIMATION SPRITE STRIP: instead of one square pose, create ONE very wide transparent image containing exactly FOUR equally spaced full-body poses in a SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW of four EQUAL WIDTH cells. No labels, no dividing lines. Same character and same pixel scale in all four cells, same head height and foot baseline. Facing RIGHT in every cell. Cell 1 left: walk contact, near leg forward, far leg back, opposite arm swing. Cell 2: passing pose, far knee moving forward, near leg straight on ground. Cell 3: opposite contact, far leg forward, near leg back, opposite arm swing. Cell 4: opposite passing pose, near knee moving forward, far leg straight on ground. Each figure centered within its own cell with 15% empty left/right margins, no body part crosses a cell boundary. No ghosts, no motion trails, no floor. Four poses exactly, readable as flipbook animation. Prioritize frame registration and matching proportions.

First Hill adjustable counterweight: ancient Greek timber-and-bronze A-frame, summit pulley, rope, open stone basket with limestone weights, trim lever and notched rail. Transparent isolated game cutout, pottery-inspired painterly finish, no text or modern parts.

Ixion's furnace wheel: monumental black iron and bronze punishment wheel mounted in a low volcanic furnace cradle with glowing coals, vent lever and bellows connection. Transparent isolated game cutout; main wheel readable as the moving part; no text or modern parts.

Danaids' leaking jar machine: monumental terracotta pithos in a bronze-and-timber measuring frame, patched and open holes, water streams, collection wheel, trough and unlabelled level gauge. Transparent isolated game cutout; no text or modern pipes.

Hephaestus bronze foundry: ancient Greek tilting crucible with glowing bronze, split-gate lever, ingot tray and automaton blueprint mould. Transparent isolated game cutout; crucible and lever readable for animation; no text or electrical machinery.

Atlas's Sky Clock: bronze armillary orrery with twelve empty house sockets, crossing rings, central dark star sphere, hand crank and monumental base. A mechanical map of the heavens, never Earth. Transparent isolated game cutout; no labels or modern parts.

Olympian Bureau apparatus: marble-and-bronze filing shrine with blank wax tablets, mechanical queue track, approval stamp and turning seal drums. Transparent isolated game cutout; no readable text, paper, or modern office objects.
